DROP TABLE "public"."user"

CREATE TABLE "public"."clientes" (
  "cpfCnpj" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "telefone" text,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."funcionarios" (
  "cargo" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "salario" float8,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mensagens_whatsapp" (
  "clienteId" text,
  "conteudo" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "funcionarioId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text,
  "numeroDestino" text NOT NULL,
  "obraId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ENVIADA' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obras" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endereco" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'EM_ANDAMENTO' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."planos_conta" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "tipo" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tenants" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documento" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transacoes_financeiras" (
  "clienteId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataPagamento" timestamptz,
  "dataVencimento" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "descricao" text NOT NULL,
  "funcionarioId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "obraId" text,
  "planoContaId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDENTE' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "tipo" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valeId" text,
  "valor" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuarios" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firebaseUid" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'USER' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."vales" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataEmissao" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descricao" text,
  "funcionarioId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "obraId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ABERTO' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "tipo" text DEFAULT 'SALARIAL' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valor" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
